hero.subtitle: Stay organized during your job search. Manage applications, track company details, and record every interaction in your hiring journey.

features.heading: Everything You Need to Manage Your Job Search

applicationTracking.title: Application Tracking
applicationTracking.description: Keep track of all your job applications with detailed status updates: ongoing, rejected, dropped-out, or hired.

companyDetails.title: Company Details
companyDetails.description: Store comprehensive company information including salary, benefits, location, website, and contact details.

interactionHistory.title: Interaction History
interactionHistory.description: Record every communication with companies during your hiring process to stay on top of your conversations.

pipelineManagement.title: Pipeline Management
pipelineManagement.description: Visualize your entire hiring pipeline and track progress through multiple interview stages.

statusUpdates.title: Status Updates
statusUpdates.description: Quickly update application statuses and see at a glance where each opportunity stands.

centralizedDashboard.title: Centralized Dashboard
centralizedDashboard.description: Access all your job applications from a clean, organized dashboard with powerful search and filtering.

cta.headingGuest: Ready to Organize Your Job Search?
cta.bodyAuthenticated: Access your applications and continue tracking your hiring journey.
cta.bodyGuest: Join now and take control of your hiring journey. Start tracking your applications today.

footer.tagline: Hiring Tool - Manage your job applications with ease
